scope.capture_and_viewing: Static owned Xvfb root at 15 FPS capture scheduling, JPEG, 640x400 viewer
scope.transport: Authenticated loopback TCP through the repository user-space fault proxy
scope.file_verification: Host staging size and SHA-256 checked. X11 host clipboard URI resolved to that staged file.
scope.input_timing: Viewer-side XTEST issue to matching key event observed on the owned host X11 window, using the same local monotonic clock.
scope.idle_timing: Same shaped connection and real viewer with no clipboard file offered yet.
scope.upload_timing: Sampled while the receiving file was partially written. Each complete trial injected 48 balanced key pairs.
scope.throughput_timing: File bytes divided by time from offering the synthetic clipboard URI to observing complete receiver staging and queueing of the clipboard update.
scope.fault_timing: Proxy termination to visible host X11 release of a previously observed held key while the file was partial. Receiver event checked every 10 ms.
scope.quantile_policy: Nearest rank over releases within an arm. Median uses the middle data values.
